references.text: Describes the same border from Atzmonah to the Brook of Egypt as part of Israel's southern boundary, with almost identical wording
Mentions the southern border (Negev) and the Salt Sea as part of the boundary description, in a parallel context
The Brook of Egypt (nachal Mitsrajim) is mentioned as God's promised land boundary to Abraham
The Brook of Egypt is mentioned as the southern boundary for the celebration under Solomon
The prophecy about gathering from the Brook of Egypt, which marks Israel's southern border
The spies surveyed the land from the Wilderness of Sin to Rehob, parallel to the boundary description
